name: Radium Development Berhad
overview: Radium Development Berhad 今年提出多元化计划，将业务扩展至医院开发与运营、普通医疗服务及相关医疗保健活动；同时通过间接子公司 Mayang Sepakat Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM45,000,888.00 收购 Selangor 一幅租赁地契土地，并已完成付款。现有物业开发业务继续推进，其他业务线今年没有公告动态。
overview_en: Radium Development Berhad proposed this year to diversify into hospital development and operations, general medical services and related healthcare activities; its indirect subsidiary Mayang Sepakat Sdn. Bhd. acquired a leasehold land in Selangor for RM45,000,888.00 and completed payment. The existing property development business continued, while no announcements were made on the other business lines this year.

segments.name: 物业开发
segments.note: 今年完成一幅 Selangor 租赁地契土地的收购付款，并推进业务多元化至医疗保健领域。
segments.note_en: Completed payment for the acquisition of a leasehold land in Selangor and pursued diversification into the healthcare business this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接子公司 Mayang Sepakat Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM45,000,888.00 收购 Selangor 一幅租赁地契土地，并于 2026 年 2 月 13 日付清余额 RM31,500,621.60。
actions.text_en: Indirect subsidiary Mayang Sepakat Sdn. Bhd. acquired a leasehold land in Selangor for RM45,000,888.00 and paid the balance of RM31,500,621.60 on 13 February 2026.

model_changes.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED DIVERSIFICATION OF THE EXISTING PRINCIPAL ACTIVITIES OF RADIUM DEVELOPMENT BERHAD ("RAD
model_changes.text_en: Proposed diversification of the existing principal activities to include hospital development and operations, general medical services and other related healthcare activities as a new business line.
